XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Engine warning light comes on, with jerky operation and limited performance
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: INJECTION | P010F | FLOW SENSOR | ENGINES | ON | MIL | YELLOW | CAUSES | LOSES | DROPS | LACK | POWER | SPEED | DROP | SIGNIFICANT | SIGNIFICANTLY | DRASTIC | DRASTICALLY |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Device: Air flow sensor

  • Fault: Engine fault light illuminated, with significant drop in performance

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: P010F (Mass Air Flow Sensor 1/2 - Inconsistent signal)

  • Cause: Faulty mass air flow sensor

• Action: Check the condition and correct operation of the air flow sensor and, if necessary, replace it.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: It is also advisable to check that the EGR solenoid valve is operating correctly. In this case, following the replacement of the air flow meter, the fault was permanently resolved.
    The component is located on the underside of the engine, between the engine and the radiator, on the passenger side.
